title: KR-Housing-LongRAG-Bench
description: A copyright-safe Korean long-context benchmark for evaluating long-context LLMs, RAG systems, and table/tool pipelines over real housing announcements, public tabular data, and housing statutes. The public release contains QA labels, evidence locators, deterministic predicates, answerability labels, split and provider/region metadata, and long-context-bundle references. It does not redistribute raw PDF/HWP/HWPX documents, bundle text, or API keys. v0.9.3 keeps the 1,997 QA, their questions and the splits of v0.9 (dev 1,608 / test_public 389) and the v0.9.2 gold fixes (evaluation scope: legal family and 5 ill-posed items excluded; 342 test_public items). Changes from v0.9.2: (1) a closed-book locator leak is fixed: for 64 count items the number of listed row ids equalled the gold count and for 4 items an id embedded the gold date; the affected items were re-run. (2) gpt-5.5 empty answers (reasoning used the whole 4,000-token cap: 63 test, 234 dev closed-book items) were re-run once at 16,000 tokens under a rule fixed in advance; all were answered. (3) A page-marker bug for Hangul page ids (18 SH announcements) is fixed; dev gold-page recall had been under-counted (40.9% reported, 74.1% matched by text); accuracy results are unchanged. (4) 122 dev items whose gold page is not in their 512k bundle are excluded from BM25, dense and full context and kept in closed-book. (5) qwen3.5 and the panel judge deepseek-v3.2 were withdrawn by their providers; deepseek-v4.1-flash replaces the latter (kappa 0.949 with 80 human labels; acceptance rule fixed in advance). Added human labels: the two non-author annotators reviewed 100 random dev items (7 errors, 7.0% [3.4, 13.7] Wilson 95%; author-confirmed), labelled the 80 judge-validation predictions independently, and labelled the 74 claude-sonnet-5-5 / claude-haiku-5-5 predictions on which six judges disagree (author settled disagreements under a rule fixed before labelling). The v0.9.2 three-annotator test review (29 of 347 items with an error, 8.4% [5.9, 11.7]) stands; its naturalness labels show 52 of 347 items marked not natural by two or more annotators (51 script-generated). Added verdicts: primary (claude-sonnet-5-5) and secondary (gpt-4.1-mini) verdicts for the re-runs, glm-5.2 with reasoning on, oracle and open-region aggregation contexts, and two Anthropic models, plus a four-judge panel. Errata: data/errata_v0.9.3.csv. Known issue: the mix_multiprovider_256k bundle is longer than its tier name (about 710k tokens; 37 items). The QA content comes from the v0.8 LLM-triage repair build. The release is not leaderboard-ready and has no sealed hidden split.
